data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 18 leaves 50, then 500 or 100. Recovery to 500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation.
